nodes.title: Video Size
widgets_values:
Width & height settings must be divisible by 64. 
Frame count must be divisible by 8 + 1. 


Running with invalid parameters **will not cause errors**. Instead, the flow will silently choose the closest valid parameters.

nodes.title: Enhanced Prompt (Positive)
widgets_values: A premium live-action cinematic shot of a 30-year-old man hosting a podcast. He sits in the center frame behind a thick, reclaimed wood desk. In the immediate left foreground, heavily blurred, is a brushed-metal microphone on a boom arm covered by a matte black foam pop filter. The man wears a casual, high-quality black cotton t-shirt. A slow, creeping push-in camera shot. He is highly animated, leaning forward toward the microphone. His mouth moves rapidly and naturally in active conversation. He raises his eyebrows playfully, smiles mid-sentence, and uses his right hand to gesture dynamically to emphasize his point. The background features shallow depth of field, showing dark charcoal acoustic foam panels and a bright, glowing purple neon light tube out of focus. Warm, soft studio lighting catches the natural texture of his skin and the slight stubble on his jaw.
